sourceSpec.normalization: Each layer is centered on a 512 x 512 transparent canvas; artboard placement below is a first-pass assembly guide.

targetRive.reviewGate: Review the assembled artboard and visible pose changes before copying any animation output to assets/sprites/.

bones.name: root
bones.purpose: Whole-character placement; gameplay owns world translation.

bones.name: torso
bones.purpose: Primary squash, stretch, breathing, and locomotion sway.

bones.name: head
bones.purpose: Face aim, hit recoil, attack anticipation.

bones.name: arm_back
bones.purpose: Rear pseudopod swing and secondary locomotion counterbalance.

bones.name: arm_front
bones.purpose: Primary reach, attack contact, and Devour grab.

bones.name: leg_back
bones.purpose: Rear planted limb and walk weight shift.

bones.name: leg_front
bones.purpose: Front planted limb and walk weight shift.

bones.name: jaw
bones.purpose: Mouth open pose for attack and Devour.

bones.name: digestion_sac
bones.purpose: Phagosome Vault glow and Devour digestion pulse.

mesh.deformationPurpose: Plant and lift with walk stride; avoid rigid rotation only.
Swing and curl through attack anticipation and Devour wrap.

parts.cleanup: Chroma-key cleaned from the regenerated magenta-background source; inspect edge fringe in Rive before approval.

mesh.deformationPurpose: Breathing, squash/stretch, and readable body recoil.
Scale and glow pulse during Devour; remain behind torso membrane.
Opposite planted limb in walk and locomotion anticipation.
Primary attack reach, contact, and Devour grab deformation.
Head aim and subtle expression squash while preserving Mako identity.
Visibility/opacity swap or jaw-open deformation for attack and Devour.

statePlan.idle: torso breathing plus small arm and head settle; loop
statePlan.walk: alternating leg/arm planted phases with torso weight shift; loop
statePlan.devour: charge, grab, mouth open, digestion sac pulse, heal, release; one-shot
statePlan.hit: whole-rig recoil with head and torso squash; one-shot

requiredStateMachineInputs.name: State
requiredStateMachineInputs.purpose: Idle, walk, attack, Devour, hit, and death selection.

requiredStateMachineInputs.name: Direction
requiredStateMachineInputs.purpose: Eight-direction locomotion blend or discrete direction selector.

requiredStateMachineInputs.name: Attack
requiredStateMachineInputs.purpose: Start attack one-shot and expose attack event markers.

requiredStateMachineInputs.name: Devour
requiredStateMachineInputs.purpose: Start Devour one-shot and expose charge/grab/swallow/digest/heal/release markers.

requiredStateMachineInputs.name: Damage
requiredStateMachineInputs.purpose: Drive hit intensity and optional flash deformation.

requiredStateMachineInputs.name: Heal
requiredStateMachineInputs.purpose: Drive Devour healing pulse and VFX intensity.

requiredStateMachineInputs.name: HitStop
requiredStateMachineInputs.purpose: Temporarily pause or slow the animation clock without moving the artboard externally.

authoringNotes: Use each PNG as a separate image/mesh object; do not flatten these layers into a single photo.
Create real Rive bones and weight/deform the meshes; external CSS transforms are not a substitute.
Keep root world translation in gameplay, but keep pose, squash, stretch, jaw, and limb motion inside the Rive state machine.
Attach animation markers to attack and Devour timelines so runtime VFX and damage are event-synchronized.
This manifest is an assembly guide, not evidence that the .riv exists or that animation is complete.
